reviewer_statement: Provisional six-domain author review. Genuine native Gaussian spline nlme fit-derived scientific arrays, source artist geometry and frozen Python 1.2 Matplotlib line comparisons are implemented and tests committed, not yet observed passing. No claim of Python statsmodels optimizer, plotting Axes runtime, or independent scientific certification.
native_language_semantic_policy: Accepted source parity scope is fitted native R Gaussian likelihood scientific plot arrays, labels, physical lag origins/uncertainty values and source horizontal reference line conventions. R base graphics returns typed scientific data; it cannot instantiate or return Python Matplotlib Axes, copy error classes, or guarantee pixel-identical backend rendering.

case_evidence.description: Pinned Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/functional_mixed_effects_diagnostics.py::plot_functional_mixed_effects_residual_variogram, matched by native strict scientific plot mode rather than replacing actual statistical calculations.

Real joint likelihood native residual diagnostics with explicit raw or covariance-whitened scale, trial curve ID, participant ID or overall summary; genuine nlme likelihood provenance required by strict R source scientific mode. No moments estimator/unknown Python Matplotlib object is substituted.

Retains source semivariance: one-half of observed within-trial squared residual differences at each index lag, x=mean observed physical time displacement; retains all paired min/max lag bounds. Native strict scientific plots compare real likelihood-derived source line arrays and labels against pinned Python 1.2 public Matplotlib artist on same diagnostics. Exact-head CI has not run green.

Fail closed for nonnative diagnostics, unselected trial/participant, unknown curve ID, invalid physical lag bounds and nonlogical strict flag; maintain valid lag zero semivariance exactly zero. Python KeyError/ValueError and axes injection are not identical.

Native strict R one-panel source semivariance artist marker=o with original Time physical-lag labels, raw/whitened residual y-axis, conditional nonuniform-lag warning title, no zero-reference line as in Python. Not a live Matplotlib Axes; default native dataframe return unchanged.

Within-trial residual process empirical semivariogram at index lags, weighted descriptive participant/overall summaries, source true physical lag offsets and no hidden Gaussian serial family selection.

independent_review_status: New tests/CI committed; no successful exact-head execution or independent source-contract certification witnessed.
language_specific_limits: Matplotlib Axes, Figure backend, injected Python ax and pixel-identical graphics cannot be produced by a native R base graphics result.
The real R nlme Gaussian spline likelihood optimizer differs from Python statsmodels MixedLM and may yield different fitted boundary estimands.
Accepted source plot data reflect the exact already-fitted native scientific model, not independently proved end-to-end optimizer parity.
The band-width ratio plot remains OPEN because current joint likelihood sensitivity intentionally refuses unqualified simultaneous bands; it is NOT counted as closed.
Independent Python exception type/state parity and external reviewer sign-off are outstanding.
